name: dsh-media-converter
description: Local media toolbox for DeepSeek Harness: convert, trim, split tracks, export subtitles, compress images, edit metadata, and Base64 — all through local ffmpeg.

scripts.build:client: vite build && cp dist/client/client.js client.js && cp dist/client/client.js.map client.js.map
scripts.build: rm -rf dist && npm run build:host && npm run build:client
scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run build && node test/client-bundle.test.mjs && node test/client-lib.test.mjs && node test/platform.test.mjs && node test/plan.test.mjs && node test/base64.test.mjs && node test/host.test.mjs
scripts.check:build: npm run build:client && git diff --exit-code -- client.js client.js.map
scripts.prepublishOnly: node -e "if (!process.env.CI) { console.error('本仓库只通过 CI 发布：npm run release -- <version>；应急可在 CI=1 下直接发布'); process.exit(1); }"
